verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform inherently processes payroll for multiple employees at once and offers contractor_payment_groups endpoints to preview/process payments to many contractors together, which is a form of bulk operation, but there's no documented generic bulk-create/bulk-update API for arbitrary object types (employees, time-off requests, etc.) and no AI-specific batch tooling beyond the MCP server for natural-language single-item queries. missing for 10: explicit bulk-create/bulk-update endpoints across resource types, batch API for employees/contractors beyond payment groups, AI-native agent examples performing bulk operations via MCP.
